meta.tagline: eavestrough cleaning and repair, booked in a minute
meta.description: Eavestrough cleaning, repair and guard installation for houses in the east end. Flat prices, photos before and after, booked online.

hero.headline: Your gutters overflowed again last week.
hero.sub: Cleaning, repair and guard installation for two-storey houses. Flat price by roofline length, photos before and after, and a date you can actually hold us to.
hero.note: Fully insured. WSIB clearance on file, shown on request.
trust: Flat price quoted before we start
Photos before and after, every job

items.title: Gutter cleaning
items.body: Hand-cleared, flushed, downspouts tested. Debris bagged and taken with us rather than left on your lawn.

items.title: Repairs and resealing
items.body: Sagging runs re-hung, loose spikes replaced with screws and ferrules, joints resealed so they stop dripping down the siding.

items.title: Guard installation
items.body: Mesh guards fitted to the run, not clipped on loosely. Stops the maple keys and the shingle grit that cause most blockages.

items.title: Downspout extensions
items.body: Water moved away from the foundation instead of pooling against it. The cheapest basement repair anyone ever does.

sections.heading: No sales visit, no surprise invoice

items.title: Send your address

items.title: Get the price and a date
items.body: One number, in writing, before anything is booked. It does not change unless you add work.

items.title: We clean, you get photos
items.body: Before and after shots of every corner, sent the same day. You do not have to climb anything to check.

items.title: Pay after
items.body: E-transfer when the job is done and you have seen the photos.

sections.heading: By roofline, not by guesswork
sections.intro: Measured from the property record before we quote. A bungalow is not charged like a three-storey semi.

tiers.name: Two storey

tiers.name: Guards
tiers.desc: Added to any clean. Priced per foot so you can do one problem side.

sections.text: They sent photos of the back corner I have never once seen in eleven years of owning this house. Turned out the downspout had never been connected.
sections.attribution: Invented testimonial — this is a sample page, not a real customer.

items.q: How often does this need doing?
items.a: Once a year for most houses, twice if you have mature maples or pines close to the roof. Booking in late autumn after the leaves are down does more good than booking in September.

items.q: Do you go on the roof?
items.a: Only when a job genuinely needs it, and only on a roof that is safe to walk. Most cleaning is done from ladders with standoffs, which is both safer and better for your shingles.
We move the date and tell you before you have rearranged your day. Wet ladder work is how people get hurt.
Yes, and the certificate plus a current WSIB clearance number go to you on request before the job, not after something has gone wrong.
